participation.context: Started from one word, and wrote the lines they would accept.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set the task, struck the four down to two, and did not praise it.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

participation.context: Corrected the field-name, and gave the white salt its peck.
participation.name: Mary Shakespeare

participation.context: Made the soap a quarrel about linen, and heard her name read back.
participation.name: Joan Shakespeare

participation.context: Struck the second spelling of bushels.
participation.name: Susanna Shakespeare

relations.quote: The list for the winter, written fair. Then you may open what you like.

story.body: You sat without a shoe and wrote the list as they corrected it. Four bushels became two. The missing letter went back into the field-name. The soap kept Joan's name. You did not open the play.

relations.quote: The list for the winter, written fair. Then you may open what you like.

title: Wrote the winter list as the house corrected it

participation.context: Wrote it fair, and left the shoe off the reward.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You ruled two leaves and stopped when the ten was done. The struck four is not on the fair page. The two is.

title: Wrote the winter list fair on two leaves

participation.context: Held the page, and left the shoe where it was.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You held the corner until the ink could be left, and you did not put the shoe on, and you did not untie the bundle.
